integrity: The matrix recurrence and asymptotic eigenvalue analysis are analytical. Exact-rational finite checks and numerical eigenvalue comparisons are supporting reproducibility evidence, not infinite proof. No authorship, outside validation, or independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite dimension, diagonal strictly convex quadratic, independent uniform singleton-coordinate sketches, exact arithmetic, initialization on the least-curved eigendirection, and a small positive curvature ratio. Iterations tend to infinity before the low-curvature asymptotic; no uniform-in-dimension or finite-precision assertion.
title: A fractional-power mean-square rate law for randomized subspace Nesterov acceleration
